```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
```

### A

```{r stocks}
stocks <- c(
  # Technology
  "MSFT", "ORCL", "ADBE", "CRM", "QCOM", "TXN",
  # Healthcare
  "JNJ", "MRK", "ABBV", "AMGN", "GILD", "MDT",
  # Financial Services
  "JPM", "BAC", "GS", "MS", "BLK", "AXP",
  # Industrials
  "CAT", "DE", "HON", "UNP", "UPS", "LMT",
  # Consumer Defensive
  "COST", "PEP", "PG", "KO", "WMT", "MDLZ"
)
tickers <- c("^GSPC", stocks)
```

### B

```{r returns}
a <- read.csv("../../data/stockData.csv", check.names = FALSE)
a$Date <- as.Date(a$Date)
a <- a[a$Date >= as.Date("2018-01-01") &
         a$Date < as.Date("2023-01-01"), ]
prices <- as.matrix(a[, tickers])
r <- prices[-1, ] / prices[-nrow(prices), ] - 1
```

### C

```{r statistics}
means <- colMeans(r)
covmat <- cov(r)
stdev <- sqrt(diag(covmat))
kable(cbind(`Mean monthly return` = means,
                   `Monthly standard deviation` = stdev), digits = 4)
```

### D

```{r assets}
assets <- data.frame(Asset = tickers, Mean = means, SD = stdev)
p <- ggplot(assets, aes(x = 100 * SD, y = 100 * Mean)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Asset), vjust = -0.7, size = 3,
            check_overlap = TRUE) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(x = "Monthly standard deviation (%)",
       y = "Mean monthly return (%)") +
  theme_minimal()
p
```

### E

```{r equal-allocation}
stock_means <- means[stocks]
Sigma <- covmat[stocks, stocks]
w_equal <- rep(1 / 30, 30)
mean_equal <- sum(w_equal * stock_means)
sd_equal <- sqrt(drop(t(w_equal) %*% Sigma %*% w_equal))
kable(data.frame(Mean = mean_equal, SD = sd_equal), digits = 4)

p_equal <- p +
  annotate("point", x = 100 * sd_equal, y = 100 * mean_equal,
           shape = 17, size = 4) +
  annotate("text", x = 100 * sd_equal, y = 100 * mean_equal,
           label = "Equal allocation", hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.8, size = 3)
p_equal
```

### F

```{r minimum-risk}
z <- solve(Sigma, rep(1, 30))
w_min <- z / sum(z)
mean_min <- sum(w_min * stock_means)
sd_min <- sqrt(drop(t(w_min) %*% Sigma %*% w_min))
kable(data.frame(Mean = mean_min, SD = sd_min), digits = 4)

p_equal +
  annotate("point", x = 100 * sd_min, y = 100 * mean_min,
           shape = 18, size = 4) +
  annotate("text", x = 100 * sd_min, y = 100 * mean_min,
           label = "Minimum risk", vjust = 1.8, size = 3)
```
